components.html:
How to play

Find the five-letter passcode in four guesses.

Four misses? The board resets automatically. Try as many times as you like.
components.css: .ds-help{width:min(calc(100% - 32px),440px);max-height:calc(100svh - 32px);overflow:auto;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:32px 24px 24px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px #0003;color:var(--ink,#e9e9e8);background:var(--hover,#24470e);font:16px/1.45 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}.ds-help h2{font:700 28px/1.15 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;margin:0 36px 16px 0;text-wrap:balance}.ds-help p{font-size:14px;margin:10px 0 18px}

narrative.overview: This local system records the user-specified Wordle geometry in the CRUSH release palette, sampled from `public/assets/crush.webp`: deep-green canvas, off-white letters, serif masthead, square letter board, and full keyboard. Play is immediate and low pressure; scoring changes instantly without decorative animation.
dos: Do preserve the four-by-five board, full keyboard, immediate scoring, and unlimited retries.
Do keep scoring meaning in text and accessibility labels as well as color.
Do update these local snapshots when source CSS changes.
donts: Don't add decorative scoring motion, daily lockouts, or leaderboard pressure.
Don't apply this standalone palette or typography to the global artist site.
